title: Number of Valid Words in a Sentence
goal: Count sentence tokens satisfying the valid-word rules.
strategy: A token may contain lowercase letters, one interior hyphen between letters, and at most one trailing punctuation mark. Digits, misplaced punctuation, and malformed hyphens invalidate it.
